papers.title: Unbounded Bayesian Optimization via Regularization
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization has recently emerged as a popular and efficient tool for global optimization and hyperparameter tuning. Currently, the established Bayesian optimization practice requires a user-defined bounding box which is assumed to contain the optimizer. However, when little is known about the probed objective function, it can be difficult to prescribe such bounds. In this work we modify the standard Bayesian optimization framework in a principled way to allow automatic resizing of the search space. We introduce two alternative methods and compare them on two common synthetic benchmarking test functions as well as the tasks of tuning the stochastic gradient descent optimizer of a multi-layered perceptron and a convolutional neural network on MNIST.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文提出了一种无边界贝叶斯优化方法，但与有限元代理模型、约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on hyperparameter tuning for machine learning models.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化中用户需手动定义搜索空间边界的问题。
summary_zh.method: 通过正则化自动调整搜索空间大小，提出两种变体方法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和神经网络超参数调优中表现竞争性。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准函数和MNIST深度学习任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the requirement of a user-defined bounding box in standard Bayesian optimization when little prior knowledge is available.
summary_en.method: Two principled modifications to Bayesian optimization are introduced that automatically resize the search space via regularization.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods show competitive performance on synthetic benchmarks and hyperparameter tuning of neural networks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two common synthetic test functions and on tuning stochastic gradient descent for MLP and CNN on MNIST.

papers.title: Is There a Benefit to Head Size Greater Than 36 mm in Total Hip Arthroplasty?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Rush University Medical Center, Chicago, Illinois

corresponding_authors.name: Bryan D. Haughom
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Rush University Medical Center, Chicago, Illinois

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，未涉及髋关节植入物的生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析，与研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No finite element modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no contact mechanics for hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨全髋关节置换术中股骨头大小大于36mm的临床获益。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床分析，比较不同头大小的术后结果。
summary_zh.result: 某些指标可能有改善，但文章缺乏生物力学评估。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether larger femoral head sizes (>36 mm) provide clinical benefits in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective clinical study comparing outcomes of different head sizes.
summary_en.result: Potential improvements in some outcomes but lacks biomechanical analysis.
